title: Can Oracle’s New App Composer Make AI Agents Useful for Your Daily Workflow?
description:
Oracle and OpenAI are now directly linking their systems, meaning your company's business software might soon be running on ChatGPT. We’re breaking down what this means for your daily workflow and how to tell if it’s actually useful or just more complexity.

What we covered:
• OpenAI expands Oracle partnership to put ChatGPT Work, Codex, and OpenAI APIs into Oracle’s enterprise software stack
• Google DeepMind Releases Genie 4 World Model With Real-Time Editing and Audio
• Google starts widening TPU distribution through partners as Oracle adds Google chips to its AI cloud menu

Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways.

Listener question: Would you prefer your AI tools to be integrated into your existing software or kept as separate, specialized applications?

What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules.

Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next.

What changed. Who wins. What you do next.
